title: DAOCP: a dual active set solver for optimal control problems
summary: We present DAOCP, a dual active set solver for linear quadratic optimal control problems with stage-wise equality and inequality constraints. Active set methods are leading Model Predictive Control benchmarks for full-body robotics, but existing solvers operate on dense QPs, while typical problem dimensions favor methods that exploit the optimal control structure.
